notes: Regenerated from current holdings with v6 region tags and enclosure_size rules.
Area membership is per full enclosure card. Established membership persists through a completely vacant card.
Vacant enclosure cards are capped at 10% of final enclosure cards and only generated inside an established >=2-card area.
No deliberate undersized placements in pregeneration. Mixed exhibits require zoo-specific evidence.

_pregeneration.area_vacancy_rule: Established membership persists while card is empty; a non-empty card leaves when no occupant has the area tag; area disappears below two connected member cards.
